references.text: In Matthew 22:21 Jesus says, "Give therefore to the emperor the things that are the emperor's, and to God the things that are God's," which relates to the payment in Matthew 17:27 to avoid causing others to stumble.

Hebrews 13:17 urges obedience to leaders and submission to them, for they keep watch over your souls as those who will have to give an account. This can be seen in light of not causing offense, as in Matthew 17:27.
